messages:
maya: Quick roundup 76 - we need a compact GA clearance artifact covering: SLA wording, docs parity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, oncall coverage, monitoring/runbooks, and pricing guardrails. Can owners list any hard blockers by EOD?
chris: I'll handle SLA text + perf validation. Proposed targets: 99.9% monthly availability (hosted control plane), latency targets as ops guidance (p50/p95 per model class). Will run perf on dedicated pools tonight.
sasha: I'll take monitoring & runbooks. Plan to publish dashboards: error-rate, latency buckets, token burn. Also drafting paging rules; need eng to provide error taxonomy.
andrew: I'll own pricing: draft three tiers (free dev quota, pay-as-you-go standard, committed reserved). Also sketch a short burst-backstop add-on. Need 7-day traffic profiles to finalize numbers.
elaine: Docs owner. I'll prepare API quickstart, migration notes, SLA page, and an appendix for Private deploy (KMS/audit). ETA: first pass tomorrow AM. Need final SLA wording and any exemptions.
maya: Do we measure SLA per-tenant or globally? Legal asked for explicit language.
chris: Recommendation: per-tenant for Dedicated/Private; global pool measurement for Hosted. Call it out in the SLA.
sasha: Suggest we document regional failover behavior and a graceful fallback policy (auto-switch to smaller model variant when capacity constrained). Monitoring will surface these events.
andrew: For pricing, I need example high-water token bursts and typical median usage. If teams can paste anonymized 95th percentiles that helps.
elaine: Will include curl healthcheck examples and expected status codes in troubleshooting. Example snippet to show expected body for success/failure.
chris: Action: perf sweep scheduled tonight. If targets missed, mark as "perf follow-up" not a docs blocker.
sasha: Action: draft runbook PR with page thresholds. Propose page on sustained error-rate >5% for 5m or token-burn anomaly >2x baseline for 10m.
maya: Decision: GA pages = SEV2 for sustained partial degradation (>5% customers) or inability to accept new requests for >3m. SEV1 reserved for full region outage.
andrew: I'll model revenue impact and propose cost offsets for burst-backstop (ops budget + surcharge).
elaine: Coordinating with security for Private KMS/HSM docs and audit-log retention appendix.
oncall-bot: Heads-up: maintenance window scheduled Fri 03:00-04:00 UTC 76 will be excluded from SLA.
maya: Owners recap: SLA+perf: chris; monitoring/runbooks: sasha; pricing+backstop: andrew; docs+deploy parity: elaine. Sync at 16:00 UTC to confirm EOD items. Drop PRs/dashboards here before the sync.
chris: Perf artifacts uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ci/perf/1766600000 76 annotated results will follow.
andrew: Pricing sketch: https://notion.redwood/pricing/ga-sketch 76 please review scenarios.
sasha: Runbook draft PR: https://git.redwood/inference/runbooks/pull/350 76 includes alert thresholds and page flows.
elaine: Docs draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/ga-clearance 76 added healthcheck examples and Private appendix.
maya: Great. If no blockers appear before 16:00, I'll mark the GA gating doc ready for legal review and notify sales. :white_check_mark:
chris: One more ask 76 quantify cold-start memory pressure for dedicated jobs so ops can size nodes. I'll add numbers to the perf artifacts.
sasha: Adding a short degraded-mode playbook (restrict max tokens/allow degraded throughput) to keep service responsive under pressure.
maya: Thanks all 76 let's close this out at the sync. :tada:
